notes.title: The Trials 2 is Coming
notes.content:
I'm excited to announce the release date for THE TRIALS 2! 🎉

3/7/2025![img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44999553/5be4300567a538a28877d3cb1d65683a91ecb710.jpg"]


The Trials is a mesmerizing puzzle and exloration game that will challenge your mind,

this game takes you on an unforgettable journey through an island filled stunning environment.

Master the art of teleportation, time manipulation, moving between alternate world to solve intricate puzzles

Each step forward unveils new challenges.
